Description.DefaultText: Shows how much waste is accumulated in your intestines. High levels can cause stress and decrease your wellbeing. This stat increases as you digest food, with less digestible foods (like those high in fiber) accelerating the increase.
Description.Text: 显示肠道中积累了​​多少残渣。高水平的残渣会造成压力并降低你的幸福度。随着食物消化，该数值会增加，而较难消化的食物（如高纤维食物）会加速残渣积累。
